note: External-risk items recorded by ClinRadar's last check, for countries it monitors. Items marked illustrative are invented for the scenario: never present them as real news. Live items from official feeds are in recorded-feeds.json and are refreshed by Run the check.

signals.title: National strike day in Belgium: no departures from Brussels Airport on 24 Nov 2026
signals.summary: A national action day is announced for Tuesday 24 November. Brussels Airport expects no departing flights and has suspended cargo handling for the day. Picket lines are possible at ports and industrial zones.

locations.effect: No departing flights; cargo handling suspended.
Staff of logistics sites may join the action.
Picket lines possible at ports and industrial zones; road transport may be slowed.

signals.title: Federal transport notice: national action day on 24 Nov 2026, disruption expected at airports and ports
signals.authority: Belgian Federal Public Service Mobility and Transport notice
signals.summary: The federal transport service expects severe disruption at Brussels Airport and at the ports on Tuesday 24 November because of a national action day.

locations.effect: Disruption expected around ports and industrial zones.

signals.title: EMEA specialty courier: tracking updates delayed on its customer portal, 14 Nov 2026
signals.authority: EMEA specialty courier service status page
signals.summary: Tracking events reach the customer portal with a delay of up to three hours. Bookings, pick-ups and flights run as planned.

locations.effect: Tracking updates delayed; bookings, pick-ups and flights unaffected.

signals.title: Ben Gurion Airport: reduced cargo handling during runway works, 4 to 8 Jan 2027
signals.summary: Planned runway works reduce cargo handling at Ben Gurion Airport from 4 to 8 January. Airlines may consolidate cargo flights; carriers will confirm bookings closer to the date.

locations.effect: Fewer cargo slots; carriers may move bookings by a day or two.

signals.title: Winter storm watch for the Lehigh Valley, Pennsylvania: heavy snow and ice, 16 to 17 Nov 2026
signals.authority: US National Weather Service, Mount Holly forecast office
signals.summary: A winter storm watch covers the Lehigh Valley, including Allentown, from Monday 16 to Tuesday 17 November: heavy snow and freezing rain are forecast. It is a forecast warning, not an observed closure. Roads to industrial sites and Philadelphia airport operations may be slowed.

locations.effect: Snow and ice may slow access to the depot and its collections.
Snow and ice may slow road transport in eastern Pennsylvania.

signals.title: Road hauliers' protest announced on the A10 and A63 motorways towards Spain, 2 to 4 Dec 2026
signals.summary: Hauliers plan slow-moving convoys and possible blockades on the A10 and A63 motorways between Bordeaux and the Spanish border.

locations.effect: Slow convoys and possible blockades between Bordeaux and the Spanish border.
